ai_summary: Ador Welding Limited announced a change in its Chief Financial Officer (CFO), with Mr. Surya Kant Sethia resigning after 11 years to pursue external opportunities. He is succeeded by Mr. Krishnamurthy Suryanarayan, a highly experienced Chartered Accountant with over 25 years in finance, including prior CFO roles at Godrej Consumer Products and ASTEC Lifesciences, who will also serve as Head - Strategy. The transition appears seamless with no significant red flags, potentially strengthening the company's financial leadership and strategic direction.
